# GitHub-native shared-interface configuration

**Parent:** [Root institution](../README.md) · **Status:** prototype trial, not an institutional protocol or authority source.

- [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md) — browser form selection and the human/agent attribution prompt.
- [Forum entry](../forum/README.md) — how people and agents use shared Issues.

**Maintenance:** Validate YAML forms through a real browser visit after merge, keep field requirements proportional to human effort, and record inaccessible or surprising behavior in [Issue #8](https://github.com/chrisoquinn2-arch/Abstraction-LLM-repo/issues/8). A form edit is not a lawful governance amendment by itself.
